The vid is a little long (~8 mins) but I can't find a decent abridged version but it covers how/why motorcycles can sometimes be pretty difficult to see because they blend in the background. Doing a side to side weave to stand out from the background in those situations can help you be seen by drivers.

This is one of the largest causes of motorcycle accidents and its something that you can (sort of) help drivers avoid. 8 minutes is pretty long for a youtube video though for most busy people. I feel like the video could be condensed into about 2 minutes but it's a pretty important topic that isn't really covered in many motorcycle courses.

Worth watching.

In town, I often run in a lower gear to make more noise. I think that also helps get noticed.
